symptom: Comments are working and audit logs are working, but comments never show up in the audit log.

root_cause_analysis.defect: Interface Contract Communication Protocol Gap between Agent 1 and Agent 3.
root_cause_analysis.mechanism: Agent 1 published domain events (`comment.created`) to an event bus, while Agent 3 monitored HTTP routes via middleware. The HTTP middleware misclassified nested route `/tasks/:id/comments` as a task mutation rather than a comment mutation, while the emitted event bus messages were never subscribed to by the audit logger.
root_cause_analysis.isolated_vs_integrated: Both features achieved 100% test pass in isolation, proving that unit tests fail to catch conflicting communication assumptions between parallel agents.

remedy: Standardize the communication contract: AuditLog service must subscribe directly to the domain event bus (ActivityFeedService / EventBus) for all entity mutations (`comment.created`, `member.invited`, `team.created`), bypassing fragile URL string parsing.
